messages:
maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up: final review timeline posted. Self-assessments due 2026-04-03 23:59 PT. Manager submissions due 2026-04-13 17:00 PT. Calibration sprint: 2026-04-17 to 2026-04-19. Hiring ops will limit external offer approvals during those dates.

owen (Eng Manager): Thanks — for teams with interviews scheduled that week, is a partial freeze possible? Some panels cover late interviews for candidates we want to keep moving.

maria (People Ops): Short answer: yes. Rita from Hiring Ops can approve targeted exceptions for high-priority candidates; please request via the Exceptions form with subject line "Interview Exception - <candidate name>". Keep requests minimal.

rita (Hiring Ops): Confirmed. We'll triage exceptions same day; include the role, urgency, and whether multiple interviewers are affected. Expect reply within 8 business hours.

kevin (IC): Quick question: peer feedback window length? Want to nudge teammates.

maria (People Ops): Peer feedback opens now and closes 2026-04-06 17:00 PT. We'll send two reminder pings: one mid-window and final-day. Please avoid sharing feedback in public channels.

owen (Eng Manager): Thanks. One more: will managers receive a checklist to ensure partner corroborations are attached for cross-team work?

maria (People Ops): Yes 12 the submission form enforces three checks (rating rationale, >=1 impact example, peer feedback attached or noted). If partner corroboration exists, add it as an attachment line. We'll run a 20-min manager norming session on 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. Recording posted.

rita (Hiring Ops): Operational note: for any approved interview exceptions, Hiring Ops will temporarily mark the candidate as "in-flight" so comp and recruiting approvals can proceed without blocking calibration work.

maria (People Ops): Final: appeals window is 7 business days post-release. For timezone extensions (APAC), managers can request a 48-hour extension via the Exceptions form. DM me for urgent cases. Thanks all :raised_hands:
